verdict.rationale: Flagright's own marketing claims watchlist screening with "fully configurable matching algorithms," which covers the configuration half of the story, but only as a single homepage line. Nothing in the pack shows alias or transliteration match handling, or how an analyst inspects why a name matched. missing for 10: documented name-matching configuration (thresholds, fuzzy settings), alias/transliteration matching, match-detail inspection for analysts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
